result.hard_numeric_fact_text: FACT: 29 Sep 2026 filing: debottlenecking of the Dahej Multi Purpose Plant (Rs75 cr funding) commissioned, commercial production and dispatch started (capacity added not disclosed in the filing). Reported Q1 FY27 (press): revenue ~Rs1,045 cr +44%, EBITDA ~Rs357 cr (34.2% margin), PAT ~Rs243 cr (+108%).

bear.assumptions: Refrigerant/CDMO cycle normalises, margin back to ~27%; FY28 EPS ~Rs190; P/E de-rates to 28x

base.assumptions: Margin 31-33% (guidance), CDMO ~US$100 mn, new capacities ramp; FY28 EPS ~Rs250 at 38x

bull.assumptions: Margin ~34%, CDMO and HPP scale faster; FY28 EPS ~Rs290 at 45x

extreme_bull.assumptions: Sustained 35%+ margin and premium multiple; EPS ~Rs330 at 50x

risk.cycle: MEDIUM: margin 34% is at/above guided 30-33% range; fluorochemical pricing is cyclical

result.thesis: Genuine reported inflection: Q1 FY27 revenue +44-49%, EBITDA ~+73-100%, PAT roughly doubled, CFO/PAT 1.35, with the Dahej MPP debottleneck just commissioned and a CDMO ramp (~US$100 mn FY27 target). But the stock is up 74% in 12 months at ~55x TTM P/E and ~41x forward; 34% margin is above the guided 30-33%, so multiple contraction and margin normalisation drive a thin ~+19% EV against -35% bear. A quality compounder already priced for it; not an early asymmetry.
chain_missing_links: Valuation gap: price already reflects the inflection
result.demand_signal: CDMO +82%, HPP +33%, specialty +48% YoY in Q1 (press-reported)
result.pricing_signal: margin +5.7-8.7 pts YoY; one-off share of EBITDA 9.8% (dossier)
result.capacity_catalyst: Dahej MPP debottlenecking commissioned 29 Sep 2026 (Rs75 cr); other capacities unknown
result.debt: Dossier ND/EBITDA 1.06 (FY-end) vs press "net debt-free" after Q1; unresolved conflict
result.valuation: TTM P/E 55.5, EV/EBITDA 38.1, mcap Rs42,267 cr (dossier). CALCULATION: TTM EPS ~Rs149; Q1 annualised EPS ~Rs190 gives ~43x. Dossier conflict: dossier YoY (rev +49%, EBITDA +100%, PAT +156%) differs from press (+44%, +73%, +108%).

plausible.2x: NO: needs EPS ~Rs380 at 43x, ~FY30 on 25% EPS CAGR

kill_conditions: EBITDA margin below 28% for a quarter
result.biggest_risk: Valuation de-rating if margins normalise toward 30% while P/E is ~55x TTM
result.next_datapoint: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin vs 32-33% guidance and CDMO revenue run-rate
